He recounts an incident involving a failed airplane ‘Sky King,’ criticizes a former co-star as incompetent, details driving lessons with critical feedback from his father, and shares concerns about testicular pain.

topics.title: Lewinsky Family Drama on Stern
topics.summary: During the Howard Stern show, discussions shift to Monica Lewinsky’s mother testifying in court regarding her daughter’s relationship with Bill Clinton. The conversation becomes tangential, involving speculation about Lewinsky's ambition and potential financial opportunities like a book deal or posing for Plant House, alongside commentary on other scandals.

topics.title: Lewinsky and Rose Arrests
topics.summary: A former Secret Service agent claims Bill Clinton had a meeting with Monica Lewinsky, including details about letting her into the Oval Office. Simultaneously, rock star Axl Rose was arrested at Phoenix Airport after security guards searched his luggage for gifts he intended to deliver.

topics.title: Princess Diana's Potential Survival Debate
topics.summary: A radio discussion explores the possibility that Princess Diana could have survived her car crash in Paris if she had received different emergency medical care. Experts debate whether the French system’s mobile hospital approach, while intended to expedite treatment, ultimately caused delays and improper initial response at the scene.
